visual_action: The video is a fast-paced montage of Kamala Harris. It opens with a close-up of her speaking, then cuts to various clips of her on the campaign trail: walking with Tim Walz and others, at a rally in a "DETROIT -VS- EVERYBODY" t-shirt, disembarking a plane and being saluted, on stage with Tim Walz in front of a "HARRIS WALZ" backdrop, at a debate stage with a chyron reading "HARRIS V. TRUMP", cooking in a kitchen, and waving to crowds.

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: She is the sole subject of the montage, appearing in every clip, and her voice is featured at the beginning stating, "I get elected president of the United States."

cast.name: Tim Walz
cast.evidence: He is shown walking with Harris and on stage with her in front of a large "HARRIS WALZ" sign.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: An on-screen chyron from a debate clip reads "HARRIS V. TRUMP," positioning him as her opponent.

cast.name: Democratic Party
cast.evidence: The account handle "@THEDEMOCRATS" is watermarked throughout the video.

on_screen_text.text: WHAT'S GONNA HELP US MOVE ON
I GET ELECTED PRESIDENT OF THE UNITED STATES

spoken_summary: The video begins with Kamala Harris saying, "Let me tell you what's gonna help us move on. I get elected president of the United States." The rest of the video's audio is a hip-hop song.
audio_music: The video starts with spoken dialogue from Kamala Harris. As she finishes her line, an upbeat, energetic hip-hop track (GloRilla's "TGIF") begins and plays for the remainder of the video, functioning as a hype track for the montage.
editing_pacing: The video is a fast-paced montage with quick cuts between various scenes, creating an energetic and dynamic feel.
cultural_references: The song playing is "TGIF" by rapper GloRilla.
The "DETROIT -VS- EVERYBODY" T-shirt worn by Harris is a reference to a popular apparel brand and slogan from Detroit.
central_claim: Electing Kamala Harris as president is the way for the country to move forward, and she has the energy and support to win.
intended_effect: To generate excitement and confidence among supporters for Kamala Harris's presidential campaign.
